_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); personal-computer and consumer-electronics signals

pit_profile.why: Apple: it 'designs and develops virtually the entire solution for its personal computers, consumer electronics, and mobile communication devices, including the hardware, operating system, several software applications, and related services', and is the 'only maker of hardware using the Mac OS', which 'has a minority market share in the personal computer market' (its own FY2007 10-K); 197 retail stores; its markets are 'highly competitive and characterized by aggressive price cutting, with its resulting downward pressure on gross margins': a margin risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Apple: it 'designs and develops virtually the entire solution for its personal computers, consumer electronics, and mobile communication devices, including the hardware, operating system, several software applications, and related services', and is the 'only maker of hardware using the Mac OS', which 'has a minority market share in the personal computer market' (its own FY2007 10-K); 197 retail stores; its markets are 'highly competitive and characterized by aggressive price cutting, with its resulting downward pressure on gross margins': a margin risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 0.08x; +105% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.22; conservative 2yr +4%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY03-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +20.5%/yr (Q4 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 5.9-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +164.7%/yr (FY03-FY07 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +340.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY07); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AAPL (retrospective, 2008-08-29) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.08x (48.7% downside to Bear $87 / +640.9% upside to Bull $1256) | Adj composite 2.44 vs market 1.22: gap +1.22 [UNDERVALUED] | +105% above the EPP floor $83 (21x FY08E $3.93) | Conservative 2-yr case: +4.1% total (+2.1%/yr) | At 43.1x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $224 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Mac units +41.5% in Q3 FY08, forward net sales +25.5% (Q4 FY08 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
